entries.title: Isaiah 52:1
segments: ¶Awake, awake; put on thy strength, O Zion; put on thy beautiful garments, Jerusalem, the holy city: for henceforth there shall no more come into thee the uncircumcised and the unclean.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:2
segments: Shake thyself from the dust; arise, sit down, Jerusalem: loose thyself from the bands of thy neck, captive daughter of Zion.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:3
segments: For thus saith Jehovah: Ye have sold yourselves for nought, and ye shall be redeemed without money.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:4
segments: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: My people went down at the first into Egypt to sojourn there, and Assyria oppressed them without cause;

entries.title: Isaiah 52:5
segments: and now, what have I here, saith Jehovah, that my people hath been taken away for nought? They that rule over them make them to howl, saith Jehovah; and continually all the day is my name scorned.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:6
segments: Therefore my people shall know my name; therefore [they shall know] in that day that I [am] HE, that saith, Here am I.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:7
segments: ¶How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that announceth glad tidings, that publisheth peace; that announceth glad tidings of good, that publisheth salvation, that saith unto Zion, Thy God reigneth!

entries.title: Isaiah 52:8
segments: --The voice of thy watchmen, they lift up the voice, they sing aloud together; for they shall see eye to eye, when Jehovah shall bring again Zion.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:9
segments: Break forth, sing aloud together, waste places of Jerusalem; for Jehovah comforteth his people, he hath redeemed Jerusalem.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:10
segments: Jehovah hath made bare his holy arm in the sight of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our God.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:11
segments: --Depart, depart, go out from thence, touch not what is unclean; go out of the midst of her, be ye clean, that bear the vessels of Jehovah.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:12
segments: For ye shall not go out with haste, nor go by flight; for Jehovah will go before you, and the God of Israel will be your rear-guard.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:13
segments: ¶Behold, my servant shall deal prudently; he shall be exalted and be lifted up, and be very high.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:14
segments: As many were astonished at thee--his visage was so marred more than any man, and his form more than the children of men

entries.title: Isaiah 52:15
segments: --so shall he astonish many nations; kings shall shut their mouths at him: for what had not been told them shall they see, and what they had not heard shall they consider.
